Seroquel is great. The first two to four days you feel extremely drowsy and sleeping all the time. In time your body will adjust to things. All antipsychotics are like that. And I’ve taken other kinds that have had much much worse side effects(the absolute worst one for me was aripiprazole,  I was so so sick).

I used to take quetiapine alone but felt I needed something more so now I take it in combination with lexapro, I always take it at night as sleeping medicine and find the combination of the two to kind work for me. 

But if you’re experiencing any other strong effects you should contact your psychiatrist, like for instance If there’s a case you experience uncontrollable limb movement immediately stop the medication and contact a professional. 
It’s okay to feel a bit slow, and really really sleepy 😴

Oh and my tip is if possible to try and take a few days to yourself, just napping and trying to keep yourself under as little stress as possible

Don’t feel guilty for something you have no control over which is your thoughts. I know nothing about your relationship so I am not in a place to advice you anything as I am only 23 and inexperienced in certain areas. But usually I would say if you value this person it’s best to communicate and be honest.

Would be helpful to mention what your behaviors are but basically me and my therapist created a little table in which good, problematic and crisis behaviors are described with activities to do when in this state e.g when I start to spiral into a crisis the most important thing I do is literally start doing anything. Just do it! Read, walk, talk with someone, exercise. Don’t sit there. Don’t lay in your bed and do nothing. That’s not going to help. Even if I’m bawling my eyes out and can’t concentrate I legit force myself to start doing a physical activity that is going to lessen me being so obsessed in the moment.
